body:
• The trailer for Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar – Parvathy Thiruvothu, Mathew dropped October 10, 2026.
  • Four officers. One unexpected turn of events. And plenty of trouble.

The makers of Pradhama Drishtiya Kuttakkar – Parvathy Thiruvothu, Mathew have released the official trailer, unveiled October 10, 2026.

Four officers. One unexpected turn of events. And plenty of trouble.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
